dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data layer contains wetlands in Newton as mapped by the Massachusetts State Department of Environmental Protection, in collaboration with MassGIS.

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. This layer will provide a basemap for layers related to real property, environmental managament and mitigation and related purposes such as urban planning, public works, or utilities purposes (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output.)
Supplemental information: The datalayer is being developed by DEP GIS group. Distribution is through MassGIS. Questions may be directed to DEP GIS to 617-574-6814.
